sentences.quote: The amendment, to become effective January 1, 2026, sets forth the agreement between the Company and Mr. McDermott that he will remain in service to the Company through at least December 31, 2030, during which time he will serve in the role of CEO, co-CEO, Executive Chairman or Non-Executive Chairman, at the discretion of the Company's Board of Directors
sentences.text: ServiceNow amended Bill McDermott's employment agreement effective January 1, 2026, committing him to the company through at least December 31, 2030 in the role of CEO, co-CEO, executive chairman or non-executive chairman at the board's discretion, alongside revised CEO severance terms.

Hossein Nowbar, most recently chief legal officer at Microsoft, joined as president and chief legal officer, with Russ Elmer moving to special counsel; Danielle Fontaine was appointed chief accounting officer on February 10, 2026, and Kevin McBride was promoted to executive vice president, accounting and corporate services.
